meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用数据讲出有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在汇报中把数据讲得动人
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your data presentations more compelling.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把原始数据整理成有结构的故事:先给结论,补上下文与对比,配图表,最后落到建议。产出的多是数据报告、汇报材料与演示内容。
howto.when: 当你要向高层或非技术听众汇报分析、做季度业务回顾、写数据驱动报告或投资人演示等内容时,它会接管。

say.text: 把这组季度数据整理成给高管的演示故事线
say.note: 按铺垫—冲突—结论结构输出

say.text: 用三个要点讲清这份分析,先说结论
say.note: 遵循三点法并前置关键发现

say.text: 把这份数据报告改写成面向非技术听众的版本
say.note: 去掉术语,补上上下文与含义

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude shapes raw data into a structured narrative: it leads with the insight, adds context and comparisons, pairs numbers with visuals, and ends with recommendations. Outputs are data reports and executive presentations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you present analytics to executives, create quarterly business reviews, write data-driven reports, or build investor presentations for non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly data into a story line for an exec deck
Explain this analysis in three points, insight first
say_en.note: Uses rule of three, front-loads findings

say_en.text: Rewrite this data report for a non-technical audience
